title: A metric page in the failed read state stays failed when another reader lands the chart for the same revision; Try again recovers
evidence: R3 from the review of PR 1548. ios/HealthRoadmap/MyData/MetricDetailView.swift:83 failed shows Try again; readChart (:151-156; MetricRead.swift:36 a failed read ignores later landings) is the only path out, and .task(id: store.revision) (:124) does not run again for the same revision. Other readers (My data series task, BloodPressureSheet) fill the store but not this page. Realistic mainly on the S31 path. US-58 AC4c
